subject: discontinuity in ode system function possible?

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: discontinuity in ode system function possible?
parts:
Hi!

I am wondering if a discontinuity in the ODE system function is fine? My situation: I have a so-called lag-time PK model. This means that a concentration of exactly 0 is in the main cmt as long as 0 < t < t_lag . For t>=t_lag the PK concentration is non-zero.

First, I wanted to integrate from t=0 to t_lag and then integrate with matching initial values from t=t_lag to all time-points I am interested in, but then I noticed that the integrate_ode call does not allow t0 to be a parameter which would be my case here.

However, nothing seems to stop me from having an if-statement inside the ODE system functor, i.e. something like

function_being_integrated:

if(t < t_lag)
  return(0)
else
 calculate me

It feels strange that the above should work, but this would put all work to the integrator to deal with the discontinuity. I would much prefer to handle the discontinuity myself by step-wise integration, but this is not possible. Any thoughts?

Many thanks!

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: discontinuity in ode system function possible?
parts:
To answer my own question: It seems to just work to integrate over a discontinuity, although I am sure that the precision is not great around the discontinuity.

Sebastian
